ruleTitle: PAGE 1 — Chapter ka Shuruaat — Mausam ka Drama
conceptText: Socho: ek winter ki subah — tum kanpte hue jaagte ho aur mote kapde pehnete ho taaki tumhe garam rakhein. Summer mein tum aise kapde chunte ho jo tumhe thanda aur comfortable rakhein. Tum apne sharir ke signals ka jawab de rahe ho — tumhara sharir mausam (weather) ko mehsoos kar raha hai! "A change in the weather is sufficient to create the world and oneself anew." — — Marcel Proust, French novelist ( matlab: mausam badalne se hi duniya aur insaan dono naye ban jaate hain!) 📷 CHITRA 2.1a — Kisi jagah par mausam ka ek roop: barf (snow) se dhaka thanda maidan aur door pahaad. Thand ka poora drama! 📷 CHITRA 2.1b — Wahi duniya, doosra roop: registan (desert) ke ret ke teele — garmi aur sookhe mausam ki nishaani. Ek hi zameen, do bilkul alag mausam! 📷 CHITRA 2.1c — Opening collage ka aur ek drishya: mausam ke alag-alag roop — garmi se thand tak, sab ek hi duniya mein! 📷 CHITRA 2.1d — Fig 2.1 ke collage ka aakhri hissa — mausam kitne alag-alag rang le sakta hai, yahi iska saboot hai! Yeh chapter hai "Understanding the Weather" — matlab mausam ko samajhna, naapna aur uski bhavishyavani karna seekhna. Book ka naam hai "Exploring Society: India and Beyond" (Grade 7, Part 1). 📷 Chapter opening page ka icon — mausam ke bade sawaalon ki nishaani! Is chapter ke 2 Bade Sawaal: 📌 Big Questions • Hum apne aas-paas ka mausam kaise naapte aur monitor karte hain? • Mausam ki predictions (bhavishyavani) humein bhaari baarish, toofan, sookha (drought) aur garmi ki lehar (heat wave) jaise events ke liye kaise taiyaar hone mein help karti hain?

text: Yeh chapter kis vishay par hai?
ans: Understanding the Weather (mausam samajhna)
explanation: Yeh chapter "Understanding the Weather" hai — matlab mausam ko naapna, samajhna aur uski prediction karna. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh kitaab NCERT ki Grade 7 SST series Exploring Society: India and Beyond hai. Iska Part 1 geography par focused hai — Chapter 1 Geographical Diversity of India aur Chapter 2 yahi Understanding the Weather. Chapter book ke page 27 se 44 tak hai.

text: Winter ki subah hum mote kapde kyun pehente hain?
options: Sharir mausam ko mehsoos karke thand ka jawab deta hai
ans: Sharir mausam ko mehsoos karke thand ka jawab deta hai
explanation: Hum apne sharir ke signals ka jawab dete hain — sharir weather ko sense karta hai, isliye thand mein mote kapde aur garmi mein halki pehne jaate hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Insaan ke sharir ka normal temperature lagbhag 37 degree Celsius hota hai. Thand mein mote kapde hawa ki ek layer band kar sharir ki garmi andar rakhte hain — yahi insulation ka funda hai. Garmi mein halki kapde paseene ko sukhne dete hain.

text: "Weather" ka simple matlab kya hai?
options: Ek particular time aur place par atmosphere (hawa ki parat) ki state
ans: Ek particular time aur place par atmosphere (hawa ki parat) ki state
explanation: Weather kisi ek samay (time) aur ek jagah (place) par Earth ke atmosphere ki state (dashaa) ko kehte hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Weather kisi ek time aur place par atmosphere ki halat hai; climate usi jagah ka lagbhag 30 saal ka average hota hai. Weather ghanton aur dinon mein badal sakta hai, climate saalon mein dheere-dheere. Yahi farq agle chapter ka mool theme hai.

text: Chapter ke shuruaati page par Marcel Proust kaun the?
ans: Ek French novelist (upanyasakar)
explanation: Marcel Proust ek French novelist the. Unhone kaha: "Mausam badalne se hi duniya aur insaan dono naye ban jaate hain." 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Marcel Proust (1871-1922) France ke novelist the. Unki saat-kitaab wali series In Search of Lost Time duniya ki sabse lambi novels mein ginti hoti hai. Time, memory aur rozmarra ke experience likhne par woh famous hain.

text: Is chapter ke 2 Bade Sawaal mein se kaun sa NAHI hai?
options: Mausam kaise naapte aur monitor karte hain?
Predictions humein bhaari baarish aur toofan se bachne mein kaise help karti hain?
India ki sabse lambi nadi kaunsi hai?
Drought aur heat wave ke liye kaise taiyaar hon?
ans: India ki sabse lambi nadi kaunsi hai?
explanation: India ki nadiyon wala sawaal Chapter 1 (Geographical Diversity) ka topic tha. Is chapter ke dono bade sawaal mausam ke naapne aur prediction se related hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Poora chapter inhi 2 Big Questions par tika hai — pehla measurement aur monitoring ka, doosra predictions ke istemal ka. Aakhri pages par Before We Move On summary inhi sawaalon ke jawab deta hai. NCERT ke har chapter aise hi big questions se shuru hote hain.

text: Upar CHITRA 2.1 mein do alag-alag mausam dikhaaye gaye hain. Kaunse?
options: Barf se dhaka thanda maidan aur registan ke ret ke teele
ans: Barf se dhaka thanda maidan aur registan ke ret ke teele
explanation: Ek tasveer mein barf se dhaka thanda maidan, doosri mein registan ke ret ke teele (sand dunes) — same duniya, bilkul alag mausam! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ret ke teelon (sand dunes) wale registan mein din-raat ka temperature range bahut bada hota hai — sookhi ret dhoop mein jaldi garam aur raat mein jaldi thand ho jaati hai. Barf wale ilaqon mein yeh range chhota rehta hai. Yahi tropical aur polar mausam ka farak hai.

text: Mausam kis cheez ki "state" (dashaa) hai?
options: Earth ke atmosphere (hawa ki parat) ki
ans: Earth ke atmosphere (hawa ki parat) ki
explanation: Weather, Earth ke atmosphere ki state hai — kisi ek samay aur jagah par. Atmosphere yani hawa ki wo parat jo Earth ko ghere hui hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Earth ki hawa lagbhag 78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen aur 1% baaki gases (argon, CO2 aadi) se bani hai. Weather isi hawa ki halat hai. Mars aur Venus ka atmosphere carbon dioxide se bhara hai — wahan bina suit ke insaan nahi ji sakta.

text: Yeh chapter kis class ki book ka hai?
ans: Class 7
explanation: Yeh Grade 7 ki NCERT SST book "Exploring Society: India and Beyond" (Part 1) ka Chapter 2 hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Class 7 ki SST kitaab Exploring Society: India and Beyond ke Part 1 mein geography ke do chapters hain — Chapter 1 Geographical Diversity of India aur Chapter 2 Understanding the Weather. Aage Chapter 3 mein climate aata hai. Weather hi uski building block hai.

text: Mausam describe karne ke liye hum kaunse words use karte hain?
options: Hot, cold, rainy, cloudy, humid, snowy, windy aadi
ans: Hot, cold, rainy, cloudy, humid, snowy, windy aadi
explanation: Hum mausam ke liye kai words use karte hain — hot, cold, rainy, cloudy, humid, snowy, windy aur bhi. Yeh sab weather ke elements ke alag-alag roop hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Mausam ke paanch elements: temperature, precipitation, atmospheric pressure, wind aur humidity. Har element ka apna instrument hai — thermometer, rain gauge, barometer, anemometer, hygrometer. Poora chapter inhi paanchon ke ird-gird ghoomta hai.

text: Mausam ki wajah se humein "naya" kyun mehsoos hota hai?
options: Mausam badalne se hamara environment aur mood dono badal jaate hain
ans: Mausam badalne se hamara environment aur mood dono badal jaate hain
explanation: Jaise Proust ne kaha — mausam badalte hi environment aur hum khud dono naye lagne lagte hain. Ek hi jagah kabhi barfili, kabhi dhoop, kabhi baarish! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Mausam hamare mood, khaana, kapde, sehat aur safar — sab par asar daalta hai. Heat wave mein 45 degree se upar school band tak ho jaate hain. Isi liye mausam samajhna sirf science nahi, daily life ki skill bhi hai.

text: Fig 2.1 ke chapter-opener collage ke photos ek saath kya dikhate hain?
options: Ek hi duniya mein mausam ke bilkul alag-alag roop
Sirf ek hi mausam ke roop
ans: Ek hi duniya mein mausam ke bilkul alag-alag roop
explanation: Ek hi duniya, mausam ke anek roop! Yahi chapter ka mool idea hai — mausam jagah aur time ke hisaab se badalta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ek hi duniya mein mausam ke bilkul alag-alag roop hote hain — barf wale poles, garam registan, geela monsoon ilaaka. Chapter opener ka collage (Fig. 2.1) yahi dikhata hai. Weather place aur time dono par depend karta hai — yahi chapter ki mool baat hai.

ruleTitle: PAGE 2 — Atmosphere — Hawa ki Cake
conceptText: Weather toh atmosphere ki state hai — par atmosphere hai kya cheez? Simple shabdon mein: atmosphere gases ki parat (layer) hai jo kuch grahon (planets) ko ghere rehti hai. Humari Earth ki case mein, in gases ko hum 'air' (hawa) kehte hain. 📷 CHITRA 2.2 — Earth ka atmosphere kai paraton (layers) wali cake jaisa hai. Sabse neeche wali parat — jahan hum sab rehte hain — troposphere hai. Uske upar tropopause , phir stratosphere (jahan ozone layer hai). Dhyaan se dekho — jaise upar jaate hain, paratein badalti jaati hain! NCERT ne ek mazedaar comparison diya hai: Earth ka atmosphere ek cake jaisa hai jisme kai paratein (layers) hain! 📌 Troposphere — Hamara Ghar Zameen (surface) se sabse paas wali parat ko troposphere kehte hain. Aur yahi wo jagah hai: 📌 Troposphere ki khaas baatein • Jahan saare jaanvar-ped (land-based plants and animals) rehte hain — humans bhi! • Jahan hum sab saans lete hain • Jahan lagbhag saara weather drama hota hai — baarish, toofan, badal... sab kuch! • Height: zameen se 6 se 18 kilometre tak Ek ajeeb si baat: troposphere poles (dhruvon) par patli hoti hai — kyunki wahan thandi hawa simat (contract) jaati hai. Aur tropical zone (garmi wala ilaaka) par moti — kyunki garam hawa fail (expand) jaati hai. Baaki paraton (stratosphere aadi) ke baare mein tum apni Science class mein padhoge. 📌 Let's Explore Mausam describe karne ke liye tumhari local bhasha ke kaunse words hain? English mein aam words hain: hot, cold, warm, chilly, crisp, pleasant aadi. Apni bhasha ke words likh kar dekho — jaise thand, garmi, kharaab mausam, bahaar!

text: Atmosphere kya hai?
options: Gases ki parat jo kuch grahon ko ghere rehti hai
ans: Gases ki parat jo kuch grahon ko ghere rehti hai
explanation: Atmosphere gases ki parat hai jo kuch planets ko ghere rehti hai. Earth ke case mein in gases ko hawa (air) kehte hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Earth ke atmosphere mein lagbhag 78% nitrogen aur 21% oxygen hai. Mars ka atmosphere 95% carbon dioxide hai, Venus ka bhi — isliye wahan bina suit ke insaan nahi reh sakta. In gases ko milkar hum air ya hawa kehte hain.

text: Earth ke atmosphere ko NCERT ne kis cheez se compare kiya hai?
ans: Kai paraton wali cake se
explanation: Earth ka atmosphere kai paraton (layers) wali cake jaisa hai — jaise cake mein alag-alag parat hoti hain, waise hawa ki bhi paratein hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Atmosphere ki paratein (layers): sabse neeche troposphere, phir tropopause, phir stratosphere jahan ozone layer hai, uske upar mesosphere aur thermosphere. Har parat ka apna temperature pattern hota hai. Inki detail tum Science class mein padhoge.

text: Zameen se sabse paas wali parat ka naam kya hai?
ans: Troposphere
explanation: Zameen se sabse nitam parat ko troposphere kehte hain. Yahi hamara ghar hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Troposphere ka naam Greek shabd tropos se aaya hai jiska matlab badalna — yahan mausam roz badalta hai. Atmosphere ke lagbhag 75-80% mass isi parat mein hai. Mount Everest (8.8 km) ke top tak bhi hum troposphere ke andar hi rehte hain.

text: Troposphere ki height zameen se kitni hoti hai?
ans: 6 se 18 kilometre
explanation: Troposphere zameen se 6 se 18 km tak jati hai — poles par kam, tropical zone par zyada. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Troposphere equator par lagbhag 18 km tak jaati hai, poles par sirf 6-8 km tak. India tropical zone mein aata hai, isliye hamare upar yeh parat moti hai. Isi motai mein jitna hawa, utna hi weather ka drama.

text: Poles par troposphere patli kyun hoti hai?
ans: Thandi hawa simat (contract) jaati hai
explanation: Poles par thandi hawa simat (contract) jaati hai, isliye troposphere wahan patli ho jaati hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Thandi hawa simat (contract) jaati hai aur garam hawa phail (expand) jaati hai — yahi physics parat ki motai decide karti hai. Antarctica ke Vostok station par 1983 mein −89.2°C ka duniya ka sabse thanda temperature napa gaya tha.

text: Tropical zone par troposphere moti kyun hoti hai?
ans: Garam hawa fail (expand) jaati hai
explanation: Tropical zone ki garam hawa fail (expand) jaati hai, isliye troposphere wahan moti ho jaati hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Tropical zone par garam hawa phail kar troposphere ko mota karti hai. Garam uthti hawa hi convection se bade badal aur bhaari baarish banati hai. Isliye equator ke paas baarish sabse zyada hoti hai — Amazon, Congo, Indonesia sab geeli jagahen.

text: Lagbhag saara weather kahan hota hai?
ans: Troposphere mein
explanation: Lagbhag saare weather phenomena (baarish, badal, toofan) troposphere mein hi hote hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Troposphere mein hi badal, baarish, toofan, garmi-thand — lagbhag saara weather hota hai. Commercial flights 10-12 km par ud kar is drama ke upar nikal jaati hain. Isliye upar pahunch kar flight smooth ho jaati hai.

text: Ozone layer kis parat mein hoti hai?
ans: Stratosphere
explanation: Ozone layer stratosphere mein hoti hai — tum iski detail apni Science class mein padhoge. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ozone layer stratosphere mein hai aur Sun ke ultra-violet (UV) kiraan ko rok-tok karti hai. 1980s mein Antarctica par ozone hole mila tha; 1987 ke Montreal Protocol ne CFC gases par rok lagayi thi. Ab yeh hole dheere-dheere bhar raha hai.

text: Land-based plants aur animals (humans samet) kahan rehte hain?
ans: Troposphere mein
explanation: Saare land-based plants, animals aur humans troposphere mein hi rehte aur saans lete hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Zameen par rehne wale saare paudhe aur jaanvar — insaan samet — troposphere ke andar hain. Samundar bhi Earth ki surface par hai, toh machhliyan bhi isi parat mein aati hain. Isliye troposphere ko hamara ghar kehte hain.

text: Troposphere ke upar wali parat ka naam kya hai (jo border ki tarah hoti hai)?
ans: Tropopause
explanation: Tropopause troposphere ke upar wali boundary (seema) jaisi parat hai — yahan se stratosphere shuru hota hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Tropopause par temperature lagbhag −60°C tak gir jaata hai — troposphere yahin ruk jaati hai. Iske upar stratosphere shuru hoti hai jahan temperature phir badhne lagta hai. Weather balloons isi boundary tak jaate hain.

text: Kitab ke hisaab se mausam describe karne ke liye English mein kaunse words aam taur par use hote hain?
options: Hot, cold, warm, chilly, crisp, pleasant aadi
ans: Hot, cold, warm, chilly, crisp, pleasant aadi
explanation: Kitab ke Lets Explore box mein yahi words diye gaye hain — har bhasha mein mausam ke apne words hote hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Har bhasha ka apna mausam ka khazana hai — Hindi mein thand, garmi, loo; Bengali mein borsha (baarish); Tamil mein mazhai. Yahi local gyaan traditional weather prediction ka pehla seedha hai. Bhasha mein jitne words, utna tikka observation.

ruleTitle: PAGE 3 — Weather ke 5 Elements
conceptText: Hum mausam ko kai words se describe karte hain — hot, cold, rainy, cloudy, humid, snowy, windy... Yeh sab asal mein weather ke elements ke roop hain jinhe hum alag-alag tarah se experience karte hain. 📌 Elements of Weather • Temperature (tapman): Atmosphere kitna garam ya thanda hai. • Precipitation: Aasman se girne wala paani kisi bhi roop mein — baarish, barf (snow), sleet ya ole (hail). • Atmospheric Pressure (vayu-mandal ka daba): Hamare upar hawa ka wazan, jo Earth ki surface par mehsoos hota hai. • Wind (hawa): Hawa ka movement — iski speed aur direction dono. • Humidity: Hawa mein maujood water vapour ki matra (kitna paani bhap ke roop mein ghula hai). Aage ke pages mein hum seekhenge ki in paanchon ko naapna kaise hai. Par pehle kuch mushkil shabd samajh lo: (Sleet: jammi hui ya adhi-jammi baarish (frozen or partly frozen rain).) (Hail (ole): chhote, sakht barf ke golas jo baarish ki tarah aasman se girti hain.) (Water vapour: paani ka gaseous (bhaap) roop — liquid nahi.)

text: Weather ke kul kitne elements hain?
explanation: Weather ke 5 elements hain: temperature, precipitation, atmospheric pressure, wind aur humidity. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Paanch elements ek saath yaad karne ka tareeka: T-P-A-W-H — Temperature, Precipitation, Atmospheric pressure, Wind, Humidity. Har element ka apna instrument aur apna unit hai. Yeh chapter ka sabse important base hai.

text: Kaun si cheez weather ka element NAHI hai?
ans: Population
explanation: Population (aabaadi) weather ka element nahi — woh geography ki cheez hai. Weather ke elements hain: temperature, precipitation, pressure, wind, humidity. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Population, nadiyan, pahaad — yeh jagah ki features hain, weather ke elements nahi. Elements sirf atmosphere ki wo halatein hain jo naapi ja sakti hain. Exam mein yeh trick sawaal aksar aata hai.

text: "Precipitation" ka matlab kya hai?
options: Aasman se girne wala paani kisi bhi roop mein — rain, snow, sleet, hail
ans: Aasman se girne wala paani kisi bhi roop mein — rain, snow, sleet, hail
explanation: Precipitation = aasman se girne wala paani kisi bhi roop mein — baarish, barf, sleet ya ole (hail). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Precipitation ke roop: boondabandi (drizzle), baarish, barf, sleet aur ole. Baarish millimetre mein aur barf centimetre mein naapi jaati hai. Latin shabd praecipitare ka matlab hi girna hai — jo upar se neeche aata hai.

text: Sleet kya hai?
ans: Jammi hui ya adhi-jammi baarish
explanation: Sleet = jammi hui ya adhi-jammi baarish (frozen or partly frozen rain). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Sleet baarish ke boond hain jo raste mein jam kar gire hain; snow upar hi crystals ban kar girti hai. Kashmir aur Himachal ki winter mein sleet aam hai. Dono ka paani ek hi — farak sirf banne ke tareeke ka hai.

text: Hail (ole) kya hote hain?
options: Chhote, sakht barf ke golas jo aasman se baarish ki tarah girti hain
ans: Chhote, sakht barf ke golas jo aasman se baarish ki tarah girti hain
explanation: Hail = chhote, sakht barf ke golas jo aasman se girti hain — jaise baarish girati hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ole (hail) garaj-chamak wale bade badalon (cumulonimbus) mein bante hain — barf ki parat dar parat chipakti jaati hai. India mein April se June tak ole girne ki khabar aam rehti hai. Bade ole fasal aur gaadiyon ko nuksaan pahunchate hain.

text: Atmospheric pressure kya hai?
options: Hamare upar hawa ka wazan jo Earth ki surface par mehsoos hota hai
ans: Hamare upar hawa ka wazan jo Earth ki surface par mehsoos hota hai
explanation: Atmospheric pressure = hamare upar maujood hawa ka wazan (weight of the air above us), jo Earth ki surface par mehsoos hota hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Samundar kinare normal pressure lagbhag 1013 millibar hota hai — lagbhag 1 kg har square centimetre par! Upar jaate hue yeh girta jaata hai. Isi pressure ko barometer naapta hai.

text: Wind ka description dene ke liye kaunsi 2 cheezein zaroori hain?
ans: Speed aur direction
explanation: Wind batate waqt uski speed (kitni tez) aur direction (kis taraf se) — dono batana zaroori hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Hawa ki speed aur direction ko naapne ke liye anemometer aur wind vane use hote hain. 1805 mein Francis Beaufort ne hawa ki speed ka 0 se 12 level ka scale banaya tha — aaj bhi sailors istemaal karte hain.

text: Humidity kya hai?
options: Hawa mein maujood water vapour ki matra
ans: Hawa mein maujood water vapour ki matra
explanation: Humidity = hawa mein maujood water vapour ki matra (amount). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Humidity ko relative humidity (percent) mein naapa jaata hai — sookhe mausam mein 20-40%, geele mein 60-80%. Monsoon wale din Mumbai-Chennai mein yeh 85% se upar chali jaati hai. Naapne wale instrument ka naam hygrometer hai.

text: Water vapour kya hai?
ans: Paani ka gaseous (bhaap) roop
explanation: Water vapour = paani ka gaseous roop — liquid nahi, bhaap. Yeh hawa mein ghula rehta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Paani ke teen roop: solid (barf), liquid (paani) aur gas (bhaap). Evaporation se liquid bhaap banta hai — isi bhaap se badal bante hain. Weather inhi roop-badlon ke khel se bana hai.

text: Temperature batati hai ki atmosphere kitna garam ya thanda hai. Isse naapne ka instrument kya hoga? (Hint: doctor bhi use karte hain!)
ans: Thermometer
explanation: Thermometer se temperature naapte hain — doctor bukhaar check karte waqt bhi thermometer hi use karte hain! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Thermometer ka naam Greek therme (garmi) se aaya hai. Galileo ne lagbhag 1592 mein pehla thermoscope banaya; Fahrenheit scale 1724 mein aur Celsius 1742 mein bani. Doctor wala clinical thermometer sirf 35-42 degree tak naapta hai.

text: Neeche diye gaye options mein se kaunsa weather ko describe karne wala word NAHI hai?
ans: Mountainous
explanation: Mountainous (pahadi) jagah ki shape batata hai, mausam nahi. Humid, snowy, windy — teeno weather words hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Cloudy, windy, humid, rainy — yeh weather ke words hain; mountainous, coastal, desert — yeh jagah ke roop. Rule yaad rakho: weather waqt ka haal hai, jagah ki pehchaan nahi. Mix karna hi exam ki common galti hai.

ruleTitle: PAGE 4 — Krishnan aur Amir ki Baat
conceptText: 📌 Think About It Socho ki Chennai ke Krishnan ki baat ho rahi hai Kashmir ke Amir se. Krishnan batata hai ki kal raat baarish hone ke baad Chennai mein thand pad gayi hai. Amir poochta hai — "kitni thand?" Ab Krishnan kaise samjhaayega? Problem yeh hai: jo cheez Krishnan ke liye thand hai, wo shayad Amir ke liye kaafi pleasant ho! (Kashmir ki sardi ke aage Chennai ki "thand" toh kuch bhi nahi.) Yani "thand" sabke liye alag-alag mehsoos hoti hai — yeh relative cheez hai. Toh Krishnan Amir ko thand ka ehsaas kaise samjhaayega? Jawab: ek common, sabke liye same tareeke se naap kar — jaise "20 degrees Celsius". Tab dono ko turant samajh aayega ki baat kitni thand ki ho rahi hai. Baaki elements (baarish, hawa, nami...) ke saath bhi yahi hai — isliye common standards se measure karna zaroori hai. 📌 Let's Explore Mausam ko zyada precisely (theek-theek) naapne ke aur kya fayde ho sakte hain? (Hint: agar pata ho ki kuch ghanton ya dinon baad mausam kaisa hoga, toh activities plan karne mein kaise help hogi?) 📌 Prakriti ke Purane Signals Purane zamane se insaanon ne Nature ko kareeb se dekha hai aur uske signals padhna seekha hai — mausam ki forecast (pehle se bata dena) ke liye. Jaise: 📌 Nature ke weather signals • Chidiyan neeche udna (birds flying low) • Cheentiyan ande utha kar le jaana • Gilhari akhrot/beej jodna (squirrels gathering nuts) • Maindak zor se tararna (frogs croaking loudly) • Pine cones (chidi ke phal) khulna-band hona Yeh sab ane wali baarish ya toofan ki khabar dete hain! Yeh gyaan pidhi dar pidhi (generation to generation) aage badha diya gaya hai. Aaj bhi India ke kai hisson mein log traditional tareeke se mausam predict karte hain — khaskar monsoon ke aane ki! (Forecast: pehle se ya kisi cheez ke baare mein aage bata dena — jaise mausam ki prediction.)

text: Krishnan kahan se tha?
ans: Chennai
explanation: Krishnan Chennai se tha aur Amir Kashmir se. Krishnan baarish ke baad ki thand ki baat kar raha tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Chennai Tamil Nadu ki coastal rajdhani hai — winter mein bhi wahan raat ka temperature 20-24 degree ke beech rehta hai. Kashmir ki December-Janvari mein temperature zero se neeche chala jaata hai. Do bilkul alag weather experience!

text: "Jo Krishnan ke liye thand hai, wo Amir ke liye pleasant ho sakta hai" — iska kya matlab hai?
options: Garam-thandi mehsoos karna har insaan ke liye alag ho sakta hai — yeh relative hai
ans: Garam-thandi mehsoos karna har insaan ke liye alag ho sakta hai — yeh relative hai

Isliye common standard se naapna zaroori hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Hamara sharir apne aap ko lagbhag 37 degree par rakhne ki koshish karta hai. Garam-thandi mehsoos karna relative cheez hai — isi liye weather apps Feels Like temperature bhi dikhati hain. Wind aur humidity feel ko badal dete hain.

text: Krishnan ko Amir ko thand kaise explain kar sakta hai?

ans: Temperature ko common standard se naap kar batayega (jaise degrees mein)

Aaj duniya ke zyada-tar desh Celsius use karte hain (America Fahrenheit). Common standard units se hi Krishnan-Amir jaisi baat-cheet possible hoti hai.

text: Mausam ko precisely naapne se kya fayda hai (Let's Explore ka jawab)?

Bas news mein dikhane ke liye

IMD kisanon ko SMS par salah bhi bhejta hai. Jitna theek prediction, utna kam nuksaan.

text: Forecast ka kya matlab hai?

explanation: Forecast = pehle se bata dena — jaise mausam ki prediction. "Weather forecast" = mausam ki bhavishyavani. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Forecast = aage ki khabar pehle se dena. IMD (India Meteorological Department) 1875 se India ka mausam naap raha hai. Aaj 5-7 din ka forecast kaafi sahi ho chuka hai.

text: Neeche diye gaye mein se kaunsa NATURE ka weather signal NAHI hai?

explanation: School ki ghanti mausam ka signal nahi! Chidiyan neeche udna, cheentiyon ka ande utha kar le jaana, maindak ka tararna — yeh sab Nature ke signals hain jo aane wali baarish/toofan ki khabar dete hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Nature ke signals: chidiyan neeche udna, cheentiyan ande utha kar upar le jaana, gilhari beej jodna, maindak zor se tararna, pine cones ka khulna-band hona. Yeh sab aane wali baarish ya badlav ki khabar dete hain. Inhe padhna hazaron saal purani science hai.

text: Traditional weather gyaan kaise pass hua?
ans: Pidhi dar pidhi (generation to generation)
explanation: Nature ke signals padhne ka gyaan pidhi dar pidhi aage badha — daada-dadi se papa-tai tak! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh gyaan bolne ke zariye (oral tradition) pidhi dar pidhi aage badha. Bharat ke panchang mein bhi mausam ke patterns darj hain. Kisan aaj bhi aasman, hawa aur pakshiyon ko dekh kar anuman lagate hain.

text: India mein log aaj bhi traditional tareeke se kya predict karte hain (khaas kar)?
ans: Monsoon ka aana
explanation: India ke kai hisson mein log traditional tareeke se monsoon (mausam-e-baarish) ke aane ka anuman lagate hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Monsoon shabd Arabic mausim (season) se aaya hai. India ki lagbhag 75% saalana baarish June se September wale monsoon se aati hai. Kheti ka poora calendar isi par tika hai.

text: Common standards se mausam naapne ki zaroorat kyun hai?
options: Kyunki "garam" aur "thanda" har insaan ke liye alag mehsoos hota hai — naap universal hona chahiye
Kyunki WhatsApp par bhejna hota hai
ans: Kyunki "garam" aur "thanda" har insaan ke liye alag mehsoos hota hai — naap universal hona chahiye
explanation: Naapne ke common standards tabhi kaam ke hain jab sabke liye same ho — 30°C sabko 30°C hi lagega (mehsoos alag ho sakta hai, par naap same!). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Har element ka apna standard unit hai: temperature °C, baarish mm, hawa km/h, pressure millibar, humidity percent. Inhi units se weather reports bante hain jo sab ke liye same matlab rakhte hain. Yahi scientific bhasha hai.

text: Krishnan ne kaha "kal raat baarish hui aur ab thand hai" — baarish ke baad thand kyun mehsoos hoti hai? (Socho!)

Geele kapdon mein thand zyada mehsoos hoti hai kyunki unka paani sukh-te waqt body se garmi le jaata hai. Evaporation ka cooling yahi hai.

ruleTitle: PAGE 5 — Prakriti ke Sitaare — Jeev-Jantoon ka Mausam Gyaan
conceptText: Chalo un Nature ke signals ko thoda kareeb se dekhte hain — kitab ne teen dhamakedaar examples diye hain: 📷 CHITRA 2.3.1 — Cheentiyan apne ande utha kar unchi jagah (higher ground) par le ja rahi hain. Yeh natural behaviour batata hai ki mausam mein bada badlav aane wala hai — khaas kar bhaari baarish ! 📷 CHITRA 2.3.2 — Western Ghats ke jungle ka ek maindak (frog) — baarish ki ummeed mein zor se tararaha raha hai! CHITRA 2.3.3 (dimaag mein banao!) — Pine cones (ek ped ke phal jo shakal se dandiye jaise lagte hain) khulne aur band hone wale natural mechanisms hain jo environmental humidity se chalte hain: • Geeli (humid) hawa mein pine cones band ho jaate hain — apne beej ko bachane ke liye! • Sookhi (dry) hawa mein khul jaate hain — taaki beej baahar gir kar fail jaayein! Smart na? Beej theek mausam mein hi failte hain! (Meteorology: mausam aur uske badlav ka systematic (vyavasthit) adhyayan. Yahi adhyayan weather forecasting ka aadhar hai. (Meteor = upar wali cheez, aasman!)) 📌 Let's Explore Apne mohalle ke buzurgon se poochho — woh mausam kaise predict karte hain? Kaunse signs dekhte hain? Apni regional bhasha ki kahawatein jo weather prediction par hain, unhe document karo! 📌 Aur Phir Aaye Scientists... Pichhle kuch saariyon (centuries) mein scientists ne weather ke elements ko bade precision (bilkul theek-theek) se naapne aur monitor karne ke tareeke dhoondh liye hain. Inhi inputs se meteorologists yeh predict karne ki koshish karte hain ki kisi ilaake ka mausam chand ghante, kuch din, ya hafte baad kaisa hoga. Toh kya woh bas aasman ki taraf dekh kar andaza lagate hain? Nahi! Unke paas kuch dhamakedaar gadgets hain — agle pages mein hum unmein se kuch dekhenge!

text: Cheentiyan ande kahan le jaati hain jab bhaari baarish aane wali hoti hai?
ans: Unchi jagah (higher ground) par
explanation: Cheentiyan ande unchi jagah par le jaati hain — taaki paani bharna toh unka ghar-ande dubo na paye! Yeh bhaari baarish ka signal hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Cheentiyan apne ande burrow (surang) se unchi jagah par le ja kar baarish se bachaati hain. Unke liye yeh disaster management jaisa hi behaviour hai. Nature ka apna warning system — aur itna accurate!

text: Cheentiyon ka ande utha kar le jaana kis mausam ka signal hai?
ans: Bhaari baarish ka
explanation: Yeh behaviour bhaari baarish (heavy rain) ke aane ka signal deta hai — mausam mein bada badlav aane wala hota hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kisan inhi signals se kheti ke kaam decide karte hain — beeju, katai, khaad. IMD ke satellite data ke saath yeh traditional gyaan kaam aata hai. Dono mila kar poori picture clear hoti hai.

text: CHITRA 2.3.2 ka maindak kahan ka hai (kitab ke hisaab se)?
ans: Western Ghats ke jungle ka
explanation: Woh maindak Western Ghats ke jungle ka hai — baarish ki ummeed mein tararaha tha! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Western Ghats ko 2012 mein UNESCO World Heritage Site ghoshit kiya gaya tha. Yahan Agumbe ko Cherrapunji of the South kehte hain — 7000 mm se zyada saalana baarish. Monsoon ka pehla stop yahi pahaad rumaal hai.

text: Maindak ki aawaz (croaking) kis cheez ki khabar deti hai?
ans: Baarish
explanation: Maindakon ka zor se tararna baarish ki khabar deta hai — frogs croaking loudly before rain! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Maindak baarish mein parne (breeding) ke liye tararte hain — nami unki skin ke liye zaroori hai. Bharat ka common bullfrog baarish ki raat mein sabse zor se bajata hai. Isliye unki aawaz baarish ki khabar maani jaati hai.

text: Pine cones geeli (humid) hawa mein kya karte hain?
ans: Band ho jaate hain
explanation: Humid conditions mein pine cones band ho jaate hain — apne beej ko bachane ke liye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Pine cones geeli hawa mein band ho kar apne beej ko nami se bachaate hain. Sookhi hawa mein khul kar beej girate hain — taaki sahi mausam mein hi failen. Yeh seed dispersal ki timing ka natural mechanism hai.

text: Pine cones sookhi hawa mein khul jaate hain. Kyun?
options: Taanaki beej baahar gir kar fail jaayein
ans: Taanaki beej baahar gir kar fail jaayein
explanation: Dry conditions mein pine cones khul jaate hain taaki beej baahar nikal kar achhe mausam mein fail jaayein — seeds release in favourable weather! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Pine cone ka khulna-band hona ek tarah ka natural hygrometer hai. Sookhi hawa mein beej door tak failte hain. Har beej ko apni timing ka pata hota hai — isi liye ped itne successful hote hain.

text: Meteorology kya hai?
options: Mausam aur uske badlav ka systematic adhyayan
ans: Mausam aur uske badlav ka systematic adhyayan
explanation: Meteorology = mausam aur uske badlav (evolution) ka systematic adhyayan. Yahi adhyayan weather forecasting ka aadhar hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Aristotle ne lagbhag 340 BCE mein Meteorologica naam ki kitaab likhi — weather science ke sabse purane granthon mein se ek. Meteorology shabd Greek meteoros (upar wali cheez) se bana hai. Modern forecasting isi parampara ka extension hai.

text: Weather forecasting kis adhyayan par bani hai?
ans: Meteorology par
explanation: Weather forecasting meteorology (mausam ka systematic adhyayan) par bani hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: India Meteorological Department (IMD) ki sthapna 1875 mein hui thi. Duniya level par World Meteorological Organization (WMO) 1950 mein bana, jaka HQ Geneva mein hai. Weather forecasting meteorology ke scientific aadhar par chalti hai.

text: Meteorologists kya karte hain?
options: Instruments ke data se predict karte hain ki mausam chand ghante/din/hafton baad kaisa hoga
ans: Instruments ke data se predict karte hain ki mausam chand ghante/din/hafton baad kaisa hoga
explanation: Meteorologists instruments ke data aur scientific methods se predict karte hain ki kisi ilaake ka mausam chand ghante, kuch din, ya kuch hafte baad kaisa rahega. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Meteorologists instruments ke data se prediction karte hain — aankhon ka andaza nahi. India mein IMD ke sainkdon observatories aur AWS stations se data aata hai. Satellite aur radar unke sabse bade hathiyar hain.

text: Meteorologists ka prediction window (time) kitna hota hai?
options: Chand ghante se kuch din, aur kabhi-kabhi hafte bhi
ans: Chand ghante se kuch din, aur kabhi-kabhi hafte bhi
explanation: Prediction window: chand ghante (few hours), kuch din (few days), ya kabhi-kabhi kuch hafte (few weeks) tak. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Forecasts ke types: nowcast (agle kuch ghante), short-range (1-3 din), medium-range (7-10 din). Jitna door ka prediction, utna kam pakka. Isi liye news mein chance (probability) ka zikr aata hai — jaise 80% chance of rain.

text: Mausam ke elements ko "great precision" se naapne ke tareeke kisne dhoondhe?
options: Pichhle kuch centuries mein scientists ne
ans: Pichhle kuch centuries mein scientists ne
explanation: Pichhle kuch saariyon (centuries) mein scientists ne weather elements ko great precision se naapne aur monitor karne ke tareeke dhoondhe hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Thermometer ka aadiroop Galileo ke time 1592 mein bana; barometer Torricelli ne 1643 mein banaya; anemometer ka pehla design Leon Battista Alberti ne lagbhag 1450 mein banaya tha. In instruments ne weather science ko scientific bana diya.

text: Mausam ke elements ko naapne ke liye kis cheez ki zaroorat thi?
ans: Special instruments (gadgets)
explanation: Elements ko precision se naapne ke liye special instruments chahiye the — jaise thermometer, rain gauge, barometer... (agle pages!) 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Aaj ek Automated Weather Station (AWS) mein saare instruments ek saath hote hain. Satellite (jaise INSAT-3DS, February 2024 mein launch hua) aur supercomputer models milkar forecast banate hain. Purane gadgets se aaj ka digital team — kitni lamba safar!

text: Ilaake ke buzurgon se mausam ke baare mein poochna aur regional kahawatein document karna — yeh kis activity ka hissa tha?
options: Let ka Explore activity — traditional weather gyaan ikattha karna
ans: Let ka Explore activity — traditional weather gyaan ikattha karna
explanation: Oral tradition ka gyaan ikattha karna — buzurgon ke nuskhe aur kahawatein asli cultural heritage hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Buzurgon ke nuskhe aksar tikte hain — barish se pehle nami ka ehsaas, ya thand se pehle hawa ka rukh badalna. Ilaaki kahawatein is gyaan ko store karke rakhti hain. Inhe document karna cultural heritage bachana hai.

ruleTitle: PAGE 6 — Thermometer — Garmi ka Hisaab
conceptText: 📌 Let's Remember (Grade 6 se) Grade 6 ki Science kitaab "Curiosity" mein tumne padha tha — thermometer ke kai types hote hain: clinical thermometer (doctor wala) aur laboratory thermometer. Temperature ke scales bhi padhe the: • Celsius scale (°C) — India mein yahi use hota hai • Fahrenheit scale (°F) — America walo ka favourite Example: mausam thanda hai — 15°C. Toh Fahrenheit mein yeh 59°F hoga! (15 × 9/5 + 32 = 59) 📌 Garmi-Thand ke Roz ke Saboot 📷 CHITRA 2.4.1 — Jab garmi hoti hai toh barf jaldi pighalti hai! (Snow melts quickly when it's warm.) 📷 CHITRA 2.4.2 — Badal chhaye mausam — "thand lag rahi hai!" (Cloudy weather — it's getting cold.) 📷 CHITRA 2.4.3 — Sardi mein nariyal ka tel jam jaata hai (solid ho jaata hai)! Temperature ka asli asar — kitchen mein bhi! 📷 CHITRA 2.4.4 — Thand mein dahi jamne mein zyada time lagta hai! (Curd takes longer to set in cold weather.) 📌 Thermometer ke Types 📌 Thermometer Family • Kuch thermometer sirf ambient temperature naapte hain (aas-paas ka, current temperature) • Kuch poore din ke maximum aur minimum temperature record karte hain • Purane thermometer mein rangei hui liquid (coloured liquid) hoti hai jo garmi mein fail (expand) jaati hai • Aaj-kal digital thermometers zyada pasand kiye jaate hain — woh zyada precise hote hain aur zyada data record kar sakte hain! (Ambient: aas-paas ka, immediate surroundings ka — ambient temperature matlab us waqt aas-paas ki hawa ka temperature.)

text: Thermometer kya naapta hai?
ans: Temperature (garmi-thand)
explanation: Thermometer temperature naapta hai — doctor wala clinical thermometer bhi isi family ka hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Galileo ke baad thermometer ke kai roop aaye. Fahrenheit (1724) aur Celsius (1742) scales isi dauraan bani. Aaj ke digital thermometers 0.1 degree tak precision dete hain.

text: Grade 6 ki Science kitaab ka naam kya tha (jisme thermometer padha tha)?
ans: Curiosity
explanation: Grade 6 ki Science kitaab ka naam "Curiosity" tha — usme clinical aur laboratory thermometer padhe the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: NCERT ki Class 6 Science kitaab ka naam Curiosity hai. Isi mein thermometer, temperature scales aur paani ke roop padhaye jaate hain. Class 7 ka yeh weather chapter usi buniyad par khada hai.

text: Clinical thermometer ka kaam kya hai?
options: Insaan ke sharir ka temperature naapna (bukhaar)
ans: Insaan ke sharir ka temperature naapna (bukhaar)
explanation: Clinical thermometer insaan ke sharir ka temperature naapta hai — doctor jab bukhaar check karte hain! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Clinical thermometer ki range 35°C se 42°C tak hoti hai — insaan ke bukhaar ki range. Mercury thermometers ab kai deshon mein band hain (Minamata Convention, 2013). Isliye digital aur infrared thermometers aage aaye.

text: Agar temperature 15°C hai, toh Fahrenheit mein kitna hoga?
explanation: 15°C = 59°F. Formula: °F = °C × 9/5 + 32. Check: 15 × 9/5 = 27, 27 + 32 = 59! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Formula: °F = °C × 9/5 + 32 — isi se 15°C = 59°F banta hai. Insaan ka normal temperature 37°C = 98.6°F hai. America wale isi liye 98.6 bolte hain.

text: Celsius ko Fahrenheit mein badalne ka formula kya hai?
explanation: Formula: °F = °C × 9/5 + 32. Jaise 15°C → 15 × 9/5 + 32 = 59°F. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Do yaad rakhne wale points: paani jamta hai 0°C = 32°F, aur khalta hai 100°C = 212°F. Beech ka farak hi 9/5 aur 32 hai. Interesting baat: −40 par dono scales ka reading same hota hai!

text: Garmi mein barf ka kya hota hai (CHITRA 2.4.1)?
ans: Jaldi pighal jaati hai
explanation: Jab warm ho, toh snow jaldi melt hota hai — garmi ka saboot toh barf ke pighne mein hi dikh jaata hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Himalaya ki barf pighal kar Ganga, Yamuna aur Brahmaputra jaisi nadiyon ko paani deti hai. Pehli garmi mein barf tezi se pighalti hai — isi liye nadiyan bharti hain. Climate change se yeh barf-line upar khisak rahi hai — yeh scientists ki chinta hai.

text: Sardi mein nariyal ka tel kaisa ho jaata hai?
options: Jam kar solid ho jaata hai
ans: Jam kar solid ho jaata hai
explanation: Sardi mein nariyel ka tel jam kar solid ho jaata hai! Temperature kitchen tak ghus jaata hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Nariyal ka tel lagbhag 24°C par jamta hai — sardi mein North India ka temperature isse neeche chala jaata hai. Ghee bhi winter mein jam jaata hai. Rasoi bhi ek temperature laboratory hai!

text: Thand mein dahi jamne ka kya hota hai (CHITRA 2.4.4)?
ans: Zyada time lagta hai
explanation: Thand mein dahi ko jamne mein zyada time lagta hai (curd takes longer to set in cold weather) — dahi ka "setting" ko warm chahiye! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Dahi Lactobacillus bacteria se banti hai — jo 30-40°C mein sabse theek kaam karte hain. Thand mein unki speed gir jaati hai, isi liye dahi der se jalti hai. Garmi mein jaldi — bacteria ki khushi!

text: Purane liquid thermometer ka working principle kya tha?
options: Garmi mein coloured liquid ka failna (expand)
ans: Garmi mein coloured liquid ka failna (expand)
explanation: Liquid thermometer mein coloured liquid hoti hai jo temperature badhne par fail (expand) jaati hai — jitni garmi, utna upar chadhna! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Purane thermometers mein mercury (para) ya rangin alcohol hoti thi — dono garmi mein failte hain. Alcohol −115°C tak kaam karti hai, mercury −39°C par jam jaata hai. Railway patriyon mein bhi expansion ke liye gap chhoda jaata hai.

text: Digital thermometers kyun zyada pasand kiye jaate hain?
options: Zyada precise aur zyada data record kar sakte hain
ans: Zyada precise aur zyada data record kar sakte hain
explanation: Digital thermometers more precise hote hain aur more data record kar sakte hain — isliye ab yahi prefer kiye jaate hain! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Digital thermometer reading 10 second mein de deta hai aur data bhi record kar sakta hai. IMD ke AWS stations digital sensors hi use karte hain. Precision ke saath memory — isliye scientists ka favourite hai.

text: "Ambient temperature" ka matlab kya hai?
options: Aas-paas ka (immediate surroundings ka) current temperature
ans: Aas-paas ka (immediate surroundings ka) current temperature
explanation: Ambient = aas-paas ke surroundings. Ambient temperature = abhi ke, aas-paas ka current temperature. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ambient ka matlab hai aas-paas ka, immediate surroundings ka. Ambience shabd bhi isi se aata hai. Weather reports mein ambient temperature matlab us waqt ki hawa ka current temperature.

text: Maximum-minimum thermometer ka kya kaam hai?
options: Ek din ke sabse zyada aur sabse kam temperature record karna
ans: Ek din ke sabse zyada aur sabse kam temperature record karna
explanation: Max-min thermometer poore din ka maximum aur minimum temperature record karta hai — subah-shaam ka hisaab ek saath! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Max-min record karne wale thermometer ko Six thermometer kehte hain — James Six ne 1780 mein banaya tha. Isi se news ki aaj-ki-maximum-temperature banti hai. Ek instrument, dono records!

ruleTitle: PAGE 7 — Range, Mean aur IMD ka Gyaan
conceptText: Temperature record karke hum kuch useful statistics nikaal sakte hain: 📌 Do khaas calculations • Range of temperature: kisi period (aam taur par 24 ghante) ka maximum temperature − minimum temperature. • Mean daily temperature: us din ka (maximum temperature + minimum temperature) ÷ 2. 📌 Ek Shehar ka Asli Data (Madhya Pradesh) Yeh ek MP ke shehar ka ek hafte ka temperature chart hai — isi table par ab quiz hoga, dhyaan se padho! Tareekh (Date) | Maximum Temperature (°C) | Minimum Temperature (°C) 28.02.2025 | 29 | 16 01.03.2025 | 30 | 15 02.03.2025 | 31 | 17 03.03.2025 | 32 | 18 04.03.2025 | 30 | 17 05.03.2025 | 28 | 14 06.03.2025 | 29 | 15 📷 India Meteorological Department (IMD) ka logo — yahi department poore India ka mausam naapti hai! 📌 Don't Miss Out! India Meteorological Department (IMD) ki sthapna 1875 mein hui thi. Iska motto (naara) hai "aadityaat jaayate vrishti" — jiska matlab hai "Sooraj se baarish paida hoti hai" (From the sun arises rain). Yeh vaakya pracheen granth Manusmriti se liya gaya hai. Poora vakya kuch aisa hai: "Sooraj se baarish aati hai, baarish se khaana, aur khaane se prani paida hote hain." Sochne wali baat: Baarish sooraj se kaise paida hoti hai? (Hint: Sooraj se garmi → paani ka bhaap banna...) (Statistics: data (jaankari) ikattha karke usme se pattern dhoondhne aur prediction karne ki technique.) 📌 Krishnan aur Amir — Part 2 Yaad hai pichhli baat-cheet? Ab agar Krishnan kahe — Chennai mein 20°C hai aur mujhe thodi thand lag rahi hai — toh Amir (Kashmir) ka reaction kaisa hoga? Kashmir ki sardi ke saamne 20°C toh kaafi pleasant hai! Par ab dono ek common standard (degrees) mein baat kar sakte hain — yahi units ka asli fayda hai.

text: Range of temperature kaise nikaalte hain?
ans: Max − Min
explanation: Range = Maximum temperature − Minimum temperature (kisi period ka, aam taur par 24 ghante ka). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Range ko diurnal range (din ki range) kehte hain. Registan mein yeh 20°C se zyada ho sakti hai, samundar kinare ke shehron mein sirf 2-5°C. Isi se pata chalta hai mausam kitna jhoolta hai.

text: Mean daily temperature ka formula kya hai?
ans: (Max + Min) ÷ 2
explanation: Mean daily temperature = (Maximum + Minimum) ÷ 2 — dono ka average! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Mean daily temperature = (Max + Min) / 2. News mein jo normal temperature bolte hain, woh 30 saal ka average hota hai (abhi ka window 1991-2020 hai). Isi se departure (DEP) nikalta hai.

text: Table ke hisaab se 03.03.2025 ko maximum temperature kitni thi?
explanation: Table dekho: 03.03.2025 ko max = 32°C (aur min = 18°C) — yeh poore hafte ka sabse garam din bhi tha! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Table-padhna ek life skill hai — mausam bulletin, share market, cricket score sab table mein hi aate hain. 03.03.2025 ko max 32°C March ke liye garam hai — summer ka aana dikh raha hai. Us din ka range 14°C tha.

text: Table ke hisaab se sabse kam (minimum) minimum temperature kis din reh gayi?
explanation: 05.03.2025 ko minimum 14°C — poore hafte ki sabse thandi subah! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 05.03.2025 ko min 14°C — hafte ki sabse thandi raat. Aisi tabdeeli aksar kisi western disturbance ya baarish se aati hai. Table ke patterns padhna data science ka pehla kadam hai.

text: 03.03.2025 ka temperature range kitna hoga? (Max 32°C, Min 18°C)
explanation: Range = Max − Min = 32 − 18 = 14°C. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Range = 32 − 18 = 14°C. Matlab subah sweater, dopahar bina sweater — ek hi din mein do mausam! Madhya Pradesh jaise ilaqon mein March mein aisa jhoolna aam hai.

text: 28.02.2025 ka mean daily temperature kya hoga? (Max 29°C, Min 16°C)
explanation: Mean = (29 + 16) ÷ 2 = 45 ÷ 2 = 22.5°C. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Mean = (29 + 16) / 2 = 22.5°C. Aise hi hafte ka ya mahine ka mean nikaal sakte ho. Exam mein yeh table-based calculation seedha poocha jaata hai.

text: India Meteorological Department (IMD) ki sthapna kab hui?
explanation: IMD ki sthapna 1875 mein hui thi — 150 saal se zyada purana mausam ka department! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: IMD ki sthapna 15 January 1875 ko hui thi — 150 saal se zyada purana department! Iska HQ Mausam Bhavan, New Delhi mein hai. 1875 mein hi India ke chhe shehron mein observatories bane the.

text: IMD ka motto kya hai?
options: Aadityaat jaayate vrishti (Sooraj se baarish paida hoti hai)
ans: Aadityaat jaayate vrishti (Sooraj se baarish paida hoti hai)
explanation: IMD ka motto hai "aadityaat jaayate vrishti" — "Sooraj se baarish paida hoti hai". 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Aadityaat jaayate vrishti Sanskrit hai: aaditya = Sooraj, vrishti = baarish. Motto mein hi water cycle ka hint chhupa hai — Sooraj se bhaap, bhaap se badal, badal se baarish. Pracheen gyaan aur modern science ek hi baat keh rahe hain.

text: IMD ka motto kis pracheen granth se liya gaya hai?
ans: Manusmriti
explanation: Yeh vaakya pracheen granth Manusmriti se liya gaya hai: "Sooraj se baarish, baarish se khaana, khaane se prani." 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Manusmriti ke alawa Varahamihira ki Brihat Samhita (lagbhag 6th century CE) mein bhi mausam ke signs ka vivaran milta hai. Pracheen Bharat mein mausam ka gyaan kaafi developed tha. IMD ne apna motto isi parampara se chuna.

text: "Sooraj se baarish paida hoti hai" — asal mein iska scientific reason kya hai?
options: Sooraj ki garmi se paani ka bhaap banta hai, jo badal ban kar baarish banta hai
ans: Sooraj ki garmi se paani ka bhaap banta hai, jo badal ban kar baarish banta hai
explanation: Sooraj ki garmi se paani evaporate (bhaap) hota hai → bhaap upar jakar badal banti hai → badal baarish ban kar girta hai. Sooraj hai hi toh water cycle chalta hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Water cycle: Sooraj ki garmi se samundar ka paani bhaap banta hai, bhaap uthti hai, thand mein condense ho kar badal banta hai, baarish girti hai. Sooraj is poori machine ka engine hai. Isliye Sooraj se baarish bilkul scientific baat hai.

text: Agar kisi din Max = 40°C aur Min = 20°C ho, toh mean hoga?
explanation: Mean = (40 + 20) ÷ 2 = 30°C. Formula lagaao, jawab paao! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Mean = (40 + 20) / 2 = 30°C. Delhi ki garmi mein aise din aam hain. News ka aaj-ka-normal bhi aise hi average se nikalta hai.

text: Statistics kya hoti hai (is chapter mein)?
options: Data ikattha karke usme pattern dhoondhne aur prediction karne ki technique
ans: Data ikattha karke usme pattern dhoondhne aur prediction karne ki technique
explanation: Statistics = data ikattha karna aur analyze karna taaki patterns samjhe ja sakein aur predictions ki ja saken. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Statistics ka tareeka: data ikattha karo, pattern dhoondo, prediction karo. IMD 30 saal ke data se normals banata hai. Yahi data climate change ke saboot bhi deta hai — jaise is dashak ki garmi normal se zyada hai.

text: Agar Krishnan kahe: Chennai mein 20°C hai aur mujhe thodhi thand lag rahi hai — Amir (Kashmir ka) ka reaction kaisa hoga?
options: Amir bhi isi thand mein kaanpega
Amir ke liye 20°C kaafi pleasant lag sakta hai — uski sardi isse bahut zyada sard hai
ans: Amir ke liye 20°C kaafi pleasant lag sakta hai — uski sardi isse bahut zyada sard hai
explanation: Relative feeling! 20°C Kashmir ki February ke muqable pleasant mausam hai. Par ab dono degree ki common bhasha mein baat kar sakte hain — yahi units ka fayda hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 20°C Chennai ke December-Janvari mein unusual thand hai — wahan winter ki raat bhi 20-24°C par rehti hai. Lekin Kashmir mein yahi 20°C pleasant summer mausam lagta hai! Ek number, do bilkul alag reaction — kyunki anubhav relative hai.

ruleTitle: PAGE 8 — Rain Gauge — Baarish ka Hisaab
conceptText: Agar khabar bole: "Aaj ek jagah par 30 mm baarish hui" — toh iska matlab kya hai? Baarish naapi kaise jaati hai? 📌 Rain Gauge — Baarish Naapne Wala Baarish ki matra ek instrument se naapi jaati hai jise rain gauge kehte hain. Iska tareeka dekho: 📌 Rain Gauge ka Design • Jab baarish hoti hai, paani ek funnel (naali/chimni ki shakal wala hissa) mein girta hai • Yeh paani ek cylinder (pipe jaise bartan) mein collect (ikattha) hota hai • Cylinder par ek measuring scale lagi hoti hai jisse paani ki gehrai (depth) naapi jaati hai Example: jab collect hui paani ki height 5 mm ho, toh hum kehte hain ki us ilaake mein 5 mm rainfall hui! 📌 Let's Explore — Apna Rain Gauge banao! Diagram jaisa rain gauge banao aur yeh rules follow karo: • Usey khuli jagah par rakho — aisi jagah jahan koi cheez baarish ko rok na de (ped, building...) • Surface flat ho — gauge jhuke ya palke (tilt/topple) nahi • Roz ek hi time par reading lo — poore mahina • Agar barf giri ho toh usey pighalne ke baad hi naapo! • Phir har hafta ka average nikalo aur dekho week-to-week variation kitna hai

text: Baarish ki matra kis instrument se naapi jaati hai?
ans: Rain gauge
explanation: Baarish naapne ke liye rain gauge use hota hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: IMD ka standard non-recording rain gauge Symons gauge kehlati hai. Aisi gauge khuli jagah par platform par rakhi jaati hai. Recording gauges (siphon wali) apne aap likhti rehti hain.

text: Rain gauge mein sabse pehle paani kahan girta hai?
ans: Ek funnel (chimni-shakal wale hisse) mein
explanation: Baarish ka paani pehle funnel mein girta hai, phir us se cylinder mein collect hota hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Funnel ka kaam poore area ke paani ko cylinder tak pahunchana hai — koi boond zayen nahi. Funnel ka mouth chauda hota hai taaki paani seedha andar jaye. Bina funnel ke hawa paani uda deti.

text: Rain gauge mein paani ki kya cheez naapi jaati hai?
ans: Uski gehrai/depth (mm mein)
explanation: Cylinder par lagi measuring scale se collect paani ki depth (gehrai) naapi jaati hai — jaise 5 mm. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 1 mm baarish ka matlab: 1 square metre par 1 litre paani. Toh 5 mm matlab 5 litre per square metre. Mumbai par 26 July 2005 ko 24 ghante mein 944 mm baarish giri thi — isi unit mein naapa gaya tha.

text: Agar rain gauge mein 5 mm paani collect ho gaya, toh kehte hain...
ans: 5 mm rainfall hui
explanation: Collect paani ki height 5 mm = 5 mm rainfall — itna hi simple! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 5 mm matlab 5 litre per square metre. IMD ke hisaab se 64.5 se 115.5 mm ka din heavy rain hota hai. Toh 5 mm halki baarish hai — par terrace par paani jama dikhne lagta hai.

text: "Us jagah 30 mm rainfall hui" — iska matlab?
options: Itni baarish ki agar zameen par kahin na bahati, toh 30 mm gehra paani khada ho jata
ans: Itni baarish ki agar zameen par kahin na bahati, toh 30 mm gehra paani khada ho jata
explanation: 30 mm rainfall = agar saara paani wahi khada rahta (na behata, na soak hota) toh 30 mm gehra paani jama hota! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 30 mm matlab har square metre par 30 litre paani. Ek hectare (lagbhag 2.5 acre) par yeh 3 lakh litre ban jaata hai! Kheti ke liye achhi baarish, sheher ke liye jal-bharav.

text: Agar barf giri ho, toh rain gauge mein naapne se pehle kya karna hoga?
ans: Pighalne ke baad hi naapna
explanation: Agar snow (barf) ho, toh usey melt (pighal) karne ke baad hi measure karte hain! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Taazi barf pighal kar lagbhag 10 guna kam paani deti hai — 10 cm barf mein lagbhag 1 cm paani. Isi liye snowfall bhi pighal kar paani ke millimetre mein ginni jaati hai. J&K wali table mein S/N centimetre mein alag column tha.

text: Rain gauge kahan rakha jaana chahiye?
options: Khuli jagah par — jahan koi baarish ko rok na sake
ans: Khuli jagah par — jahan koi baarish ko rok na sake
explanation: Rain gauge open area (khuli jagah) par — jahan koi cheez baarish ko obstruct (rok) na sake. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Koi bhi avrodh — ped, building, deewar — baarish ko rok ya moedata hai, data kam ya galat aata hai. Isi liye official stations khuli zameen par hote hain. Behtareen site: khula aasman, flat surface, upar platform.

text: Rain gauge ka jhukna (tilt) kyun problem hai?
options: Paani sahi se collect nahi hota aur reading galat aati hai
ans: Paani sahi se collect nahi hota aur reading galat aati hai
explanation: Agar gauge jhuka hua ya palne wala ho, toh paani sahi se collect nahi hoga aur reading galat aayegi — isliye flat surface zaroori! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Jhuka gauge bina wajah ka kam ya zyada paani dikha sakta hai. Scientists ka rule: instrument ki position hi data ki quality hai. Zyada-tar IMD gauges level kar ke lagti hain.

text: Reading roz kis tarah leni chahiye?
ans: Roz ek hi samay par
explanation: Reading roz ek hi time par leni chahiye — tabhi toh din-bhar-din comparison sahi hoga! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: IMD ki readings fixed time par hoti hain — subah 8:30 aur shaam 5:30 IST (0830/1730). Yeh synoptic hours kehte hain; duniya bhar ek saath data leti hai. Consistency se hi comparison possible hai.

text: Ek mahine ka data lekar hum kya nikaal sakte hain?
options: Har hafta ka average aur week-to-week variation
ans: Har hafta ka average aur week-to-week variation
explanation: Poore mahine ka data lekar har hafta ka average nikal sakte hain aur dekh sakte hain ki week se week baarish mein kitna farak aaya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Mahine ka data hafte ke averages mein compare hota hai. Aise hi IMD monsoon ka track rakhta hai — India ka saalana monsoon normal lagbhag 87 cm hota hai. Isse kam padne par drought ka khatra banata hai.

text: Rain gauge ke teen hisse kaunse hain?
ans: Funnel, cylinder aur measuring scale
explanation: Rain gauge = funnel + cylinder + measuring scale. Baaki options doosre instruments ke parts hain! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Rain gauge ke teen hisse: funnel, cylinder (measuring tube) aur scale. Standard gauge mein tube tang hoti hai taaki thode paani mein bhi gehrai saaf dikhe. Parts yaad rakho — baaki instruments ke parts se mix na hona!

text: Mausam ka kaun sa element rain gauge naapta hai?
ans: Precipitation
explanation: Rain gauge precipitation (baarish, barf, sleet, hail — sab) naapta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Elements-instruments ka jodi: temperature-thermometer, precipitation-rain gauge, pressure-barometer, wind-anemometer aur vane, humidity-hygrometer. Chapter ke aakhri sawaal mein yahi matching thi. Paanchon yaad matlab poore marks!

ruleTitle: PAGE 9 — Hawa ka Wazan — Atmospheric Pressure
conceptText: Humara sharir temperature aur baarish ko aasanee se mehsoos karta hai. Par kabhi-kabhi mausam "bhaari" (heavy) lagta hai — jaise garaj-chamak se pehle. Yeh feeling atmospheric pressure se judi hai — hamare upar aur aas-paas maujood hawa ka wazan jo Earth ki surface par daba daalta hai. 📷 CHITRA 2.7 — Hawa ka daba: garam hawa upar uthti hai → wahan pressure kam (lower pressure) , aur thandi hawa neeche baithti hai → wahan pressure zyada (higher pressure) . Yehi farak mausam ke poore khel ki chaabi hai! 📌 Samundar Kinare vs Pahaad 📌 Pressure ka Geography Rule • Samundar kinare (sea coast): atmospheric pressure zyada • Pahaadon par upar jaate hue: pressure kam hota jaata hai • Pahaad par chadhte waqt hawa patli (thinner) ho jaati hai — plain ke muqable • Patli hawa = oxygen kam — isliye height par saans larna mushkil! Patli hawa mein oxygen kam milta hai — tumhare phephdon (lungs) mein jaane wala oxygen bhi kam. Aur khoon mein oxygen kam gaya toh sharir ko kaam karne ke liye aur mehnat karni padti hai! Isliye log pahaadon par kabhi-kabhi saans phoolna, chakkar aana ya thakan mehsoos karte hain.

text: Atmospheric pressure kya hai?
options: Hamare upar aur aas-paas ki hawa ka wazan jo Earth ki surface par dabav deta hai
ans: Hamare upar aur aas-paas ki hawa ka wazan jo Earth ki surface par dabav deta hai
explanation: Atmospheric pressure = hamare upar ki hawa ka wazan, jo Earth ki surface par pressure (dabav) deta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Sea level par pressure lagbhag 1013 millibar hota hai — lagbhag 1 kg har square centimetre par. Upar jitni kam hawa, utna kam wazan — isliye upar jaate hue pressure girta hai, lagbhag har 10 metre par 1 millibar.

text: Garaj-chamak (thunderstorm) se thodi der pehle mausam "bhaari" kyun lagta hai?
options: Barish ke boond bhaari hote hain
ans: Atmospheric pressure ke badlav se
explanation: Yeh "heavy" feeling atmospheric pressure ke saath judi hai — toofan se pehle pressure badal jaata hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kai log pressure ke badalte hi sar dard ya badan mein bhaaripan mehsoos karte hain — hamara sharir bhi ek pressure sensor hai. Toofan se pehle nami bhi badhti hai. Isliye purane kehte the: hawa bhaari lag rahi hai!

text: Atmospheric pressure samundar kinare kaisa hota hai?
ans: Zyada
explanation: Samundar kinare pressure zyada hota hai, aur pahaadon par upar jaate hue kam hota jaata hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Samudra-tal (sea level) par upar poore column ka wazan seedha deta hai — isliye wahan pressure ka reference sabse zyada hota hai. 1013 mb ko standard atmosphere kehte hain. Yahi sab naap ki zero-line hai.

text: Pahaad par chadhte hue hawa ka kya hota hai?
ans: Patli (thin) hoti jaati hai
explanation: Pahaad par jaate hue hawa patli (thinner) hoti jaati hai — plain ke muqable mein kaam hawa. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Upar jaate hue hawa patli hoti jaati hai — molecules kam milte hain. Lagbhag 5,500 m par pressure aadha reh jaata hai. Isi liye wahan saans phoolti hai — Everest base camp level par bhi!

text: Patli hawa mein kya kam milta hai?
ans: Oxygen
explanation: Patli (thin) hawa mein oxygen kam hota hai — aur hamare lungs ko kaam karna padta hai usse nikaalne ke liye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Hawa ka composition upar bhi same rehta hai (21% oxygen) — farak sirf density ka hai. 8,000 m ke upar death zone kehte hain — wahan bina extra oxygen ke manushya der nahi tikta. Everest climbers bottled oxygen le jaate hain.

text: Pahaadon par log kabhi-kabhi saans phoolna, chakkar aana ya thakan kyun mehsoos karte hain?
options: Kyun ki patli hawa mein kam oxygen jaata hai — aur body ko zyada mehnat karni padti hai
ans: Kyun ki patli hawa mein kam oxygen jaata hai — aur body ko zyada mehnat karni padti hai
explanation: Patli hawa → kam oxygen lungs aur khoon mein → body ko chalane ke liye zyada mehnat — isliye saans phoolti hai, chakkar aata hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kam oxygen par body ko zyada mehnat karni padti hai — dil tez dhadakta hai, saans tez chalti hai. Dheere-dheere jaane par body adjust ho jaati hai (acclimatisation). Achanak upar pahunch kar daudna khatarnak hai.

text: CHITRA 2.7 ke hisaab se garam hawa ka kya hota hai?
options: Upar uthti hai — wahan pressure kam hota hai
ans: Upar uthti hai — wahan pressure kam hota hai
explanation: Garam hawa upar uthti hai — aur jahan se wo uthti hai wahan lower pressure ban jaata hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Garam hawa halki hoti hai aur uthti hai — jahan se pressure kam hota hai. Yahi convection badal aur baarish banata hai. Din ki sea breeze isi se samundar se zameen ki taraf aati hai.

text: Thandi hawa kahan rehti hai (CHITRA 2.7 ke hisaab se)?
options: Neeche baith kar wahan pressure zyada banati hai
ans: Neeche baith kar wahan pressure zyada banati hai
explanation: Thandi hawa bhaari hoti hai, neeche baith-ti hai — aur wahan higher pressure bana deti hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Thandi hawa bhaari hoti hai aur neeche baith kar high pressure banati hai. Winter ki saaf aasman isi high pressure se aati hai. Wind ka engine yahi pressure ka farak hai — high se low!

text: Kya atmospheric pressure plains mein hamesha zyada hi rehta hai?
options: Nahi — kabhi-kabhi wahan bhi pressure gir kar "depression" ban sakta hai
ans: Nahi — kabhi-kabhi wahan bhi pressure gir kar "depression" ban sakta hai
explanation: Nahi! Plains/coast mein bhi kabhi-kabhi pressure naatak ke girta hai — jise "depression" (low-pressure system) kehte hain — jo toofan ya cyclone ban sakta hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Monsoon ke dauraan Bay of Bengal se depressions aate hain — yahi baarish ke main carrier hote hain. Depression matlab 1000 mb se neeche gira pressure. Cyclone isi ka bada roop hai.

text: Kya atmospheric pressure hamesha samundar kinare hi zyada hota hai?
options: Haan, kinare par pressure kabhi nahi badalta
Nahi — wahan bhi pressure girta hai (depression/cyclone ke waqt)
Nahi, kyunki samundar mein pressure hota hi nahi
ans: Nahi — wahan bhi pressure girta hai (depression/cyclone ke waqt)
explanation: Coast par aam taur par pressure zyada hota hai, par toofan/cyclone ke waqt wahan bhi pressure dramatically gir jaata hai — na ki hamesha high! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Coast par bhi pressure gir sakta hai — cyclone toh samundar par hi banta hai! India ki east coast par Bay of Bengal ke cyclone sabse zyada aate hain. 1999 ka Odisha super cyclone isi ka sabse bada udaaharan hai.

ruleTitle: PAGE 10 — Pahaad, Sainik aur Depression
conceptText: 📷 CHITRA 2.8 — Hamari army ke jawan Ladakh ke Khardung La jaisi unchi jagahon par serve karte hain — jo sea level se 5600 metre se bhi upar hai! Wahan oxygen bahut kam hai — atmospheric pressure lagbhag sirf 650 millibars ! 📌 Acclimatise — Body ka Adjust Karne ka tareeka Acclimatise ka matlab hai — naye mausam ya halat ke saath apne aap ko adjust kar lena. Unchi jagahon par jaane walon ko raaste mein thode-thode pauses (breaks) lene ki salah di jaati hai — taaki body aahista-aahista unchi jagah ki kam oxygen aur patli hawa ke saath acclimatise ho jaaye. 📌 Depression — Pressure ka Villain Yeh zaroori nahi ki atmospheric pressure plains mein ya coast par hamesha hi zyada rahe. Kabhi-kabhi wo naatak ke gir kar "depression" (low-pressure system) bana deta hai — jise meteorologists depression ya low-pressure system kehte hain. Yeh depression kabhi-kabhi aage badh kar toofan (storm) ban jaata hai — aur kabhi-kabhi cyclone tak!

text: "Acclimatise" ka matlab kya hai?
options: Naye mausam ya nayi halat ke saath apne aap ko adjust kar lena
ans: Naye mausam ya nayi halat ke saath apne aap ko adjust kar lena
explanation: Acclimatise = naye climate (mausam) ya condition (halat) mein apne aap ko adjust kar lena. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Acclimatisation mein body dheere-dheere kam oxygen ke saath adjust hoti hai — khoon mein laal cells badh jaate hain. Leh (3,500 m) par pahunch kar pehla din aaram karna samajhdari hai. Army aur trekkers isi rule par chalte hain.

text: Unchi jagahon par jaate waqt raste mein pauses (breaks) kyun lene kehte hain?
options: Taaki body acclimatise ho sake — dheere-dheere patli hawa ke saath adjust ho
ans: Taaki body acclimatise ho sake — dheere-dheere patli hawa ke saath adjust ho
explanation: Pauses lene se body ko acclimatise hone ka time milta hai — warna achanak kam oxygen se chakkar, ulti, thakan ho sakti hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Mountaineers ka rule: climb high, sleep low — din mein upar jao, raat ko thoda neeche sona. Achanak upar pahunch kar heavy exercise karna Acute Mountain Sickness (AMS) de sakta hai — sar dard aur jee machalna. Pauses lena hi iska ilaaj hai.

text: Khardung La kahan hai?
ans: Ladakh
explanation: Khardung La, Ladakh mein hai — aur yeh sea level se 5600 metre se bhi upar hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Khardung La Ladakh mein hai aur Leh ko Nubra Valley se jodta hai. Ladakhi bhasha mein La ka matlab pahaad ka darra (pass). Siachen glacier isi raste ki taraf hai — isliye yahan army ki zabardast mehnat hai.

text: Khardung La sea level se kitna upar hai?
ans: 5600 metre se bhi upar
explanation: Khardung La over 5600 metres (5.6 km!) sea level se upar hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kitab ke mutabik Khardung La sea level se 5,600 metre se bhi upar hai. Mount Everest 8,848.86 m (2020 mein revise hua) — usse chhota, par phir bhi bahut uncha. Wahan cycle chalane ka world record bhi bana hai.

text: Khardung La par atmospheric pressure lagbhag kitna hota hai?
ans: 650 millibars
explanation: Khardung La par pressure lagbhag 650 millibars hota hai — normal sea-level pressure (1013 mb) se bahut kam! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 650 millibar matlab sea level pressure (1013 mb) ka lagbhag 64%. Yani har saans mein oxygen bhi utna hi mil raha hai. Aisi jagah par jeena aur kaam karna army jawanon ki asli himmat ka imtihaan hai.

text: Normal sea-level pressure (≈1013 mb) ke muqable 650 mb ka matlab?
options: Lagbhag aadha pressure — bahut patli hawa
ans: Lagbhag aadha pressure — bahut patli hawa
explanation: 650 mb, 1013 mb ka lagbhag 65% hai — yani bahut kam pressure, bahut patli hawa aur kam oxygen! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Hawa ka composition upar bhi same rehta hai (21% oxygen) — farak density ka hai. Patli hawa mein molecules kam, toh har saans mein oxygen kam milta hai. Isliye wahan kaam karna do guna mehnat hai.

text: "Depression" (low-pressure system) kya hai?
options: Jab atmospheric pressure dramatically gir jaata hai
ans: Jab atmospheric pressure dramatically gir jaata hai
explanation: Meteorology mein depression = atmospheric pressure ka dramatically gir jaana — jise low-pressure system bhi kehte hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Depression ke saath wind andar ki taraf spiral mein ghoorti hai. Isse bada ho kar storm banta hai, aur samundar par cyclone tak. Barometer ka girna hi iski pehli khabar hoti hai.

text: Depression kabhi-kabhi kya ban jaata hai?
ans: Toofan (storm) ya cyclone
explanation: Depression (low-pressure system) kabhi-kabhi toofan (storm) ban jaata hai — aur kabhi-kabhi cyclone tak! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Cyclone samundar ka bada low-pressure system hai. Bay of Bengal se aane wale cyclone India aur Bangladesh ko sabse zyada hit karte hain. 1999 Odisha super cyclone aur 2013 Phailin isi category ke bade events the.

text: Hamari army kahan serve karti hai (is page ke hisaab se)?
ans: Ladakh jaisi unchi (high-altitude) jagahon par
explanation: Hamari army Ladakh ke Khardung La jaisi unchi jagahon par serve karti hai — jahan oxygen bahut kam aur pressure sirf ~650 mb! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Indian Army Siachen glacier (lagbhag 6,000 m) jaise ilaqon mein bhi serve karti hai — duniya ka sabse uncha battlefield, 1984 se. Wahan dushman se pehle mausam se ladna padta hai — thand −50°C tak ja sakti hai.

text: Khardung La jaisi jagahon par jeena aur kaam karna kyun mushkil hai?
options: Wahan oxygen level bahut kam hai
ans: Wahan oxygen level bahut kam hai
explanation: Wahan oxygen level bahut kam hai — atmospheric pressure bhi sirf ~650 mb. Sochna mushkil ki wahan jeena-kaam karna kitna kathin hoga! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Unchi jagah ke logon ke khoon mein laal cells zyada hote hain — body ka natural adjustment. Ladakh ke log iski live misal hain. Sea level se aaye logon ko wahan 2-3 din lagte hain set hone mein.

text: Sea level se upar jaate hue pressure ka kya hota hai?
ans: Girta jaata hai
explanation: Upar jaate hue atmospheric pressure girta jaata hai — kyunki upar wali hawa ka kam column neeche dabaata hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Upar jaate hue lagbhag har 10 metre par 1 millibar pressure girta hai. Jahaz ka altimeter (height naapne wala instrument) isi principle par kaam karta hai. Pressure girna matlab height badhna.

ruleTitle: PAGE 11 — Barometer — Daba naapne Wala
conceptText: Atmospheric pressure naapne ke liye instrument ka naam hai barometer. Thermometer ki tarah, barometer ke bhi kai types hote hain. 📌 Barometer ki Baat • Unit jisme yeh dikhaata hai: aam taur par millibar (mb) • Samundar kinare normal atmospheric pressure ≈ 1013 mb • Agar pressure 1000 mb se neeche chala jaaye → yeh depression (low-pressure system) ki nishaani! 📌 Think About It Atmospheric pressure naapna kyun important hai? Aise measurements kaun log sabse zyada use karte honge? (Socho: pilots? kisan? mausam ki team?) Jawab: pressure ke badlav se hi toofan aur cyclone ki khabar milti hai. Meteorologists barometer ka data dekh kar batate hain ki koi low-pressure system aa raha hai ya nahi. Pilots ke liye bhi pressure ka pata hona zaroori hai — unchi hawa mein udan bharti (flying) ke liye!

text: Atmospheric pressure naapne wale instrument ka naam kya hai?
ans: Barometer
explanation: Pressure naapne ka instrument = barometer. ("Baro" = daba/wazan, "meter" = naapne wala!) 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Pehla barometer Evangelista Torricelli ne 1643 mein banaya tha — mercury wala. Aneroid barometer mein liquid nahi hota. Digital barometer aaj smartphones mein bhi aa jaata hai!

text: Barometer kya naapta hai?
ans: Atmospheric pressure (hawa ka daba)
explanation: Barometer atmospheric pressure naapta hai — hawa ke dabay ka hisaab-kitaab. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ghar ke purane barometer utaar-chadhav dikhate the — nani ke zamane ka weather app. Girna matlab kharab mausam aane wala, chadhna matlab saaf mausam. Aaj yahi kaam satellite aur radar karte hain.

text: Barometer reading kis unit mein dikhta hai (aam taur par)?
ans: Millibar (mb)
explanation: Barometer aam taur par millibar (mb) mein reading dikhata hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Millibar (mb) aur hectopascal (hPa) ek hi unit hai — weather maps par dono likhe jaate hain. Standard atmosphere = 1013.25 mb = 760 mm mercury column. Unit ka naam alag, naap same!

text: Samundar kinare normal atmospheric pressure lagbhag kitna hota hai?
explanation: Sea coast par normal atmospheric pressure lagbhag 1013 mb hota hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 1013 mb ko yaad rakhne ka tareeka: 10-13, jaise October 13! Yeh sea level ka standard pressure hai. Exam mein seedha poocha jaata hai — pakka number hai.

text: Agar barometer 1000 mb se neeche dikhaye toh kya samajhna chahiye?
ans: Depression (low-pressure system) ki nishaani
explanation: Pressure 1000 mb se neeche = depression ki nishaani — low-pressure system aa gaya hai, toofan ka khatra! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 1000 mb ke neeche pressure depression ki nishaani hai. Jitna gehra (low) pressure, utna bada toofan. 1999 ke Odisha super cyclone ka pressure lagbhag 912 mb tak gir gaya tha — bahut gehra low!

text: Barometer ke kitne types hote hain?
ans: Kai (several) types
explanation: Thermometer ki tarah barometer ke bhi several types hote hain — design ke hisaab se alag-alag. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Barometer ke types: mercury wala (Torricelli ka classic), aneroid (bina liquid wala) aur digital. Jahaz ka altimeter asal mein aneroid barometer hi hai. Kaam sabka same — pressure naapna.

text: Kaun log barometer ka data sabse zyada use karte hain?
options: Meteorologists aur pilots (mausam ki team aur udan bharti karne wale)
ans: Meteorologists aur pilots (mausam ki team aur udan bharti karne wale)
explanation: Meteorologists (pressure se toofan-cyclone ki khabar) aur pilots (flying ke liye pressure zaroori) — dono barometer ke data par depend karte hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Pressure data ke bade users: meteorologists (forecast ke liye), pilots (altimeter ke liye), mountaineers (weather window ke liye) aur machhuaare (toofan warning ke liye). Disaster agencies bhi isi par chalti hain.

text: Pilots ke liye atmospheric pressure ka pata hona kyun zaroori hai?
options: Kyunki patli hawa mein udan bharti (flying) affected hoti hai
Kyunki pressure se TV chalta hai
Kyunki aur kuch karna nahi hota
ans: Kyunki patli hawa mein udan bharti (flying) affected hoti hai
explanation: Unchi hawa mein pressure kam aur hawa patli hoti hai — flying par asar padta hai, isliye pilots ko pressure ka data chahiye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Altimeter pressure se height naapta hai — upar pressure girta hai, wahi height ban jaati hai. Pilots flight levels pressure par hi set karte hain. Cabin pressure maintain karna bhi zaroori hai — warna 10,000 m par saans nahi aata!

text: Depression bante hi meteorologists kya karte hain?
options: Warning jaari karte hain — jaise machhuaaron ko samundar mein na jaane ko
ans: Warning jaari karte hain — jaise machhuaaron ko samundar mein na jaane ko
explanation: Depression ki khabar milté hi warnings jaari ki jaati hain — jaise samundar wale machhuaaron ko "abhi na niklo" ka ishaara! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Cyclone ki chetavni IMD rangon mein deta hai — green (no warning), yellow (watch), orange (alert), red (warning). Book ke map wale levels isi se milte hain. Machhuaron ko SMS tak bheja jaata hai.

text: Agar barometer tezi se girne laga hai toh kya expected hai?
ans: Kharab mausam — toofan ka khatra
explanation: Barometer ka tez girna = pressure dramatically gir raha hai = kharab mausam ka signal — toofan aa sakta hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Barometer ka tezi se girna matlab toofan jaldi aa raha hai. Purani kahawat thi: barometer gir raha hai toh chhata le lo! Instrument ki bhasha samajhna ek skill hai.

text: 1013 mb ka pressure kis level par maana jaata hai normal?
ans: Samundar kinare (sea coast)
explanation: 1013 mb samundar kinare (sea level) ka normal pressure hai — pahaadon par yeh kam hota jaata hai (Khardung La par ~650 mb!). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Sea level ko zero reference maana jaata hai — sab height isi se naapi jaati hai. Mount Everest ki height 8,848.86 m (2020 mein revise) isi hisaab se hai. Pressure ka standard 1013 mb bhi isi level ka hai.

ruleTitle: PAGE 12 — Wind — Hawa ki Chal
conceptText: Wind (hawa) ka matlab hai: hawa ka high pressure wali jagah se low pressure wali jagah ki taraf bahna (movement of air). Yaad karo CHITRA 2.7 — garam hawa uthti hai (low pressure), thandi baith-ti hai (high pressure) — aur yahi farak hawa ko chalata hai! Hawa batate waqt 2 cheezein khaas zaroori hain: uski speed (kitni tez) aur direction (kis taraf se / kis taraf ko). 📌 Hawa Kyun Important Hai? 📌 Wind ke kaam • Weather forecasting mein madad — hawa ki direction se pata chalta hai mausam kahan se aa raha hai • Pilots aur sailors (naav wale) ke liye wind ka data zaroori — flying aur sailing par hawa ka bahut asar hota hai • Kisan hawa ki direction se andaza lagate hain ki baarish kahan se aa sakti hai • Zyada wind speed se mitti jaldi sookhti hai (soil dries faster) Sochne wali baat: Kya tumne hawa mein udte hue beej dekhe hain? Agar hawa na chale toh beejon ka kya hoga? (Agle page par iska jawab — pehle yeh page test karo!) (Loo: uttar Bharat ki garmi mein chalne wali tez, garam aur dhool bhari hawaein — yeh bhi wind ka hi ek roop hai (aur kitab mein yeh agla page aane wala example hai!).)

text: Wind (hawa) kya hai?
options: Hawa ka high pressure se low pressure ki taraf bahna (movement of air)
ans: Hawa ka high pressure se low pressure ki taraf bahna (movement of air)
explanation: Wind = hawa ka high pressure ilaake se low pressure ilaake ki taraf bahna. Pressure ka farak hi hawa ko chalata hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Wind pressure ke farak se paida hoti hai — high se low ki taraf. Din mein zameen garam hoti hai, hawa uthti hai, samundar se thandi hawa aati hai (sea breeze). Raat ko ulti (land breeze). Yahi convection ka khel hai.

text: Hawa high pressure se kis taraf jaati hai?
options: Aur zyada high pressure ki taraf
ans: Low pressure ki taraf
explanation: Hawa high pressure se low pressure ki taraf chalti hai — hamesha! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: High se low — bilkul paani ke nicheche behte hue jaisa. Beach par din mein hawa samundar se aati hai, raat ko zameen ki taraf. Monsoon bhi seasonal scale par yahi hai!

text: Wind ko describe karne ke liye kaunsi 2 cheezein batani padti hain?
ans: Speed aur direction
explanation: Wind ki speed (kitni tez — km/h mein) aur direction (kis taraf se chal rahi hai) — dono batana zaroori! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Speed anemometer se, direction wind vane se — dono mila kar poora wind data. Beaufort scale (1805) ne hawa ko 0 (shaant) se 12 (toofan) tak categories mein baanta tha. Weather report mein dono batate hain: 25 km/h, north-westerly.

text: Weather forecasting mein wind ka data kaise kaam aata hai?
options: Hawa ki direction se pata chalta hai mausam kahan se aa raha hai
Sirf picture mein acha lagta hai
ans: Hawa ki direction se pata chalta hai mausam kahan se aa raha hai
explanation: Hawa ki direction se mausam ka pata chalta hai — jaise samundar se aati hawa = nami aur baarish ki khabar, registan se aati hawa = sookhi garmi! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Hawa ki direction se pata chalta hai mausam kahan se aa raha hai — winter mein western disturbances se North India mein baarish-barf aati hai. Bengal mein April-June ki Kalbaisakhi (norwester) toofan isi disha se aata hai. News mein yahi words sunai dete hain.

text: Pilots aur sailors wind ka data kyun dekhte hain?
options: Kyunki hawa ka flying aur sailing par bahut asar hota hai
ans: Kyunki hawa ka flying aur sailing par bahut asar hota hai
explanation: Flying aur sailing par wind ka bahut bada asar hota hai — isliye pilots aur sailors ke liye wind ka data zaroori hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Plane takeoff aur landing hawa ke against karte hain — zyada lift milta hai. Crosswind limit se zyada ho toh flight ruk jaati hai. Purane samay ki naavein sail hawa par hi chalti thi — aaj bhi sailors wind data ke bina samundar mein nahi nikalte.

text: Kisan hawa ki direction ka kya use karte hain?
options: Andaza lagane ke liye ki baarish kahan se aa sakti hai
ans: Andaza lagane ke liye ki baarish kahan se aa sakti hai
explanation: Kisan hawa ki direction dekh kar andaza lagate hain ki baarish kahan se aa sakti hai — samundar se aati hawa toh baarish ka chance! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Monsoon ka safar hawa ki direction se hi pata chalta hai — southwest monsoon samundar se aata hai. Kisan dekhte hain ki baarish ke badal kis taraf ja rahe hain. Isi se kheti ke kaam plan hote hain.

text: Zyada wind speed ka mitti par kya asar hota hai?
options: Mitti jaldi sookh jaati hai (soil dries faster)
Mitti mein ped ugg jaate hain
ans: Mitti jaldi sookh jaati hai (soil dries faster)
explanation: Zyada wind speed se soil jaldi sookhta hai (soil dries faster) — kisanon ke liye yeh bhi khaas baat hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Tez hawa evaporation tez karti hai — mitti sookh jaati hai. Rajasthan jaise tez-hawa wale ilaake sookhe hain. Kheti mein windbreak (pedon ki deewar) isi se bachaav ke liye lagte hain.

text: Loo kya hai?
options: Uttar Bharat ki garmi mein chalne wali tez, garam aur dhool bhari hawaein
ans: Uttar Bharat ki garmi mein chalne wali tez, garam aur dhool bhari hawaein
explanation: Loo = uttar Bharat (north India) ki garmi (summers) mein chalne wali tez, garam aur dhool-bhari hawaein. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Loo uttar Bharat ki garmi (May-June) ki dopahar wali tez, garam aur dhool-bhari hawa hai. Iske saath temperature 45°C se upar chala jaata hai — heatstroke ka khatra. Isliye garmi ki dopahar bahar nikalna avoid karne ko kehte hain.

text: Loo kis mausam mein chalti hai?
ans: Garmi (summers) mein
explanation: Loo garmi ke mausam (summers) mein chalti hai — uttar Bharat mein. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: IMD ka heat wave criteria: plains mein max 40°C tak aur normal se 4.5°C se zyada upar. Severe heat wave: 6.5°C se zyada upar. Loo-belt — UP, Bihar, Delhi, Rajasthan — mein yeh aam ho jaata hai.

text: Agar hawa na chale toh kya hoga? (Think About It ka hint — agla page!)
options: Beej fail na payenge, mausam ka bahut kuch atak jayega
ans: Beej fail na payenge, mausam ka bahut kuch atak jayega
